problem: Urban commuters often drive alone, increasing traffic, emissions, and costs, while lacking a simple, offline‑first way to find reliable local carpool partners with matching schedules.
solution: Carpool Connect lets users create recurring ride offers or requests, match based on route, time, and seat availability, and confirm rides via a lightweight UI that works fully offline and stores data in the browser.

competitors.name: Waze Carpool
competitors.difference: Waze requires accounts and internet; Carpool Connect is offline‑first, no login, and stores data locally.

competitors.name: BlaBlaCar
competitors.difference: BlaBlaCar focuses on intercity trips and payment processing; our app targets short daily commutes and is free with no payments.

features: Create recurring ride offers or requests with start/end locations, time, and seat count
Automatic matching of compatible rides within a 5‑km radius
Accept or decline matches with one‑click confirmation
Local storage of all rides and matches for offline access
Responsive design for mobile and desktop

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer a premium tier with export to CSV and custom route colors for $2.99/month after 1000 rides stored.
monetization.free_tier: Unlimited ride creation, matching, and local storage up to browser limits.

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free-tier limits
launch_strategy: Publish repo on GitHub with GitHub Pages enabled
Share on local commuter forums and university bulletin boards
Collect feedback via a simple in‑app survey stored in localStorage

marketing_content.tagline: Ride together, save money, cut traffic.
marketing_content.social_post: 🚗💚 Tired of driving alone? Carpool Connect lets you find nearby commuters with matching schedules – all offline, no login needed. Try it now on GitHub Pages! #carpool #commute #opensource

tests: Create a ride offer for 8:00 AM, 2 seats, route A→B; create a ride request for 8:05 AM, 1 seat, same route – the app should show a match and allow acceptance.
Turn off internet, reload page – previously saved rides and matches should persist and be viewable.
next_improvements: Add map preview using OpenStreetMap static images
Implement export/import of rides via JSON file
Introduce optional email notifications using mailto links
